💡 This study establishes HOMO-level alignment relative to iodine's redox potential as the governing design descriptor for donor–acceptor COFs in aqueous zinc–iodine batteries, replacing empirical trial-and-error. The optimally designed NT-COF achieves stable cycling at ~50.5 wt% iodine loading and reliable low-temperature operation, showing that rational COF design must couple energy-level alignment with structural conjugation.
